# v2.32 Release Notes

This stable release rolls up dev pre-releases **v2.31-dev … v2.32-dev** since the
previous stable (v2.30). Three improvements to the student and Training Data
admin screens.

## Fixed

- **Student edit — Country no longer wrongly flagged "needs theatre."** When
  editing a student, the Country dropdown could show a misleading, cut-off
  "(needs theatre — fix in Region Data)" note against a country whose Theatre
  was actually configured — it happened when the country list hadn't finished
  loading. The note now appears only once the list has loaded and only for a
  country that genuinely has no Theatre set, with shortened wording
  (`⚠ no theatre`) that never truncates. A brief "Loading countries…"
  placeholder shows while the list loads instead of a false warning.

## What's new

- **Training Data — filters survive opening a training.** On
  **Admin → Training Data**, your search text, column filters, "show legacy
  only" toggle, and sort direction are now remembered when you open a training
  and click **Back**. They're mirrored to the page URL, so the filtered view is
  also bookmarkable.

- **Training Data — see which ILTs / OLXs lead to a certification.** An ILT or
  OLX is the recommended preparation before sitting the exam that earns a
  certification (it does not itself grant the cert). Where a training leads to a
  cert is now surfaced without entering edit mode:
  - In the list, a **"→ Leads to: …"** subline appears under the Full Title,
    naming the certification(s) — styled like the existing "→ Replaced by"
    legacy subline.
  - On the Full Title detail page, a **Leads to Certification(s)** card sits in
    the summary row (next to Function(s)), listing the deduplicated
    certifications drawn from all mapped training titles.
  - The certification picker (when adding/editing an ILT/OLX) is labelled
    **"Leads to Certification(s)"** for clarity.

## Notes

- No database changes and no configuration changes. Nothing to do after
  updating.
